flags.text: Kill lead, shit conversion: team gold 69.4k to 81.1k, and Yin's 42402 objective damage dwarfed the allied 15602.
Enemy took the final five kills, two on Gideon outside any detected fight, while Countess razed mid.

Still the damn engine: Sparrow's 35528 hero damage led the game, and 12 kills tied Yin's.

focus.title: Turn won fights into towers
focus.action: After each won fight, the team hits the nearest standing tower before farming camps, and in the late game Gideon crosses the map only beside Sparrow, Argus or Scarlett.

13.1.call: Won 3-0 on the duo lane in the enemy half, Sparrow killing Riktor and Skylar and Argus killing Yin, and the allied Fangtooth followed. Pick off the enemy duo, then take Fangtooth.

20.8.call: Won 4-2 on the duo lane in the enemy half, with Gideon's rotation kills on Countess and Yin, and Scarlett then took the enemy offlane outer. Sound conversion; chain the next tower the same way.

23.1.call: Two separate plays: Sparrow scored all three allied kills on the duo lane while Yin killed Gideon and Scarlett on the offlane, and the allied duo and offlane outer towers fell in the window. When Yin shows offlane, Gideon and Scarlett back off together.

29.7.call: Lost 0-3 in separate plays: Shinbi killed Scarlett on the offlane, Yin killed Yurei in the enemy jungle and Countess killed Sparrow on the duo lane, then Orb Prime went to the enemy. Three allies down means conceding Orb Prime and holding mid.

d335f21e-99d5-4eb5-9d6f-47ad406b142d: Four of five deaths went to Yin, two shortly before enemy Fangtooth takes. Before the next Fangtooth, confirm Yin's location with vision or a teammate before entering the pit.
First blood on Shinbi, then kills on Countess, Skylar twice and Yin, plus seven assists. When Sparrow fights on the duo lane, keep joining to finish the kill.
One ward placed against a 1.7 norm and 2 enemy wards cleared. Before each gank into the enemy jungle, clear or place vision at the jungle entrance first.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Six kills on Skylar after dying to Skylar three times first, plus five kills on Riktor. Keep forcing duo-lane fights the moment Skylar is down.
Both deaths to Countess came late, the second shortly before enemy Orb Prime. When Countess is unseen late, stay behind Scarlett until Feast is used.
Two early deaths to Skylar came soon after Argus fell on the duo lane. If Argus drops early, back off instead of taking the next trade.
6dbf5d5c-f0eb-4f9b-b25b-3b559f69df97: 894 hero damage per minute on a 690 norm, plus the enemy offlane outer. Once an outer falls, call Gideon and the jungler before sieging the inner.
Three of four deaths went to Yin, two on the offlane. When Yin is unseen and Shinbi holds the lane, play back until a teammate shows.
d8f70ff1-af3e-4a5a-b0e7-d325196d98d5: All four kills came on duo-lane rotations, three after an ally died there, and an enemy tower fell soon after. Repeat that trip when the duo lane fights.
Three of four deaths came outside any detected fight, including the game's last kill. After taking an enemy outer, ward the nearby jungle entrance before pushing further.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Eleven assists, the game's most, plus three kills on Riktor and one on Yin. Keep stacking damage on the target Sparrow commits to.
Seven wards beat a 5.8 norm, but Riktor placed 22 and the enemy out-warded the team 50 to 33. Before each Fangtooth, fill Silentium's three-ward cap around the pit.

threats: Chain-CC risk (4 hard-CC abilities, ~3.3s of lockdown): Countess Feast (suppress 0.75s), Riktor Riplash (pull), Riktor Shock Therapy (silence 0.8s), Riktor Skewer (suppress 1.25s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
Dive threat on our backline: Countess. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Anima Burst / Whispering Echoes apply Soul Rip → Severance resets on Soul-Ripped targets → Soulstorm pulls them in
ourKits.winCondition: chain Severance resets to stick to a target and burst in melee
ourKits.passive: casting grants ranged empowered basics + attack speed
ourKits.playWith: follow-up CC to hold the target she dashes onto
ourKits.playAgainst: her chain needs Soul Rip resets — peel/disengage breaks it; punish when Severance is on cooldown

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
ourKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
ourKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
ourKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
ourKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

ourKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
ourKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
ourKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel

enemyKits.combo: Shadow Slip in → Eventide → Blade Siphon → Feast suppress ult, Haemorrhage true-damage
enemyKits.winCondition: Feast-suppress a squishy and delete them with true-damage burst
enemyKits.passive: two-ability hits apply a %max-HP true-damage bleed
enemyKits.playWith: a team to clean up after her pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: Feast is her whole engage — bait it / peel; she's fragile, punish the recast window

enemyKits.combo: Rushing Beat dashes → Line Tempo wolves → Circle Rhythm shield → All-Kill! wolfpack ult
enemyKits.winCondition: stack Track and unleash All-Kill! in a grouped fight
enemyKits.playAgainst: spread vs the wolfpack; she's squishy without her shield up

enemyKits.combo: Riplash pull → Shock Therapy silence → Skewer suppress ult
enemyKits.winCondition: pull a target in and chain silence+suppress for a guaranteed kill
enemyKits.playWith: burst that deletes his pulled/suppressed target
enemyKits.playAgainst: respect Riplash range — stay spaced; cleanse/QSS the suppress

enemyKits.combo: Lash Kick gap-close+slow → Windburn %hp basics → Backlash push, Quelling Gale to disengage
enemyKits.passive: Rising Storm stacks grant attack speed
enemyKits.playWith: a team that lets her side-lane and pick
enemyKits.playAgainst: she wants 1v1s — group and burst her; Quelling Gale only stops projectiles

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade → Hypercharge on-hit → Air Assault reposition → Atomiser ult
enemyKits.winCondition: Hypercharge and kite-shoot from Air Assault safety
enemyKits.passive: extra jump; kills cause corpse explosions
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline so she can free-fire airborne
enemyKits.playAgainst: CC her out of Air Assault; she's squishy on the ground

lines: Lead story: Healed through fights. 827 healing a minute, more than 92% of Yin jungle players this patch.
Yin dealt 34,866 hero damage, 30% of their team's, with +257 physical power from items.

Penetration: Manta Scythe 10, Vanquisher 12; against Yurei (level 16: about 99 physical armor, 77 after penetration; took 9,507 physical damage from heroes, 58% of all hero damage they took) and Scarlett (level 17: about 114 physical armor, 92 after penetration; took 14,997 physical damage from heroes, 43% of all hero damage they took) that is about 12% and 11% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Manta Scythe (item): Against Enemy Units within 2500u: If they have no Ally within 1000u of themselves, deal 8% more damage to them.
Scattershot (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Summon 2 projectiles from the Target. These home towards the closest Enemies. Each deals (+40%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.
Storm Breaker (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Release a bolt of lightning that chains to 7 Targets.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Weald (Eternal): Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage.

Sustain: 21% lifesteal; Equinox: On going below 40% Health: Gain a 350-750 Shield for 4s. Shield size increases with Level.; Liberator: Cleanse all Debuffs. (game text: Purifying Guard:  Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.) Field: 51.6% in 1700 games, 47% of picks, level the hero-role's 50.9%.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 7 effects on one trigger: Manta Scythe, Scattershot, Storm Breaker, Sky Splitter, Weald, Taproot, Storm of Salvation.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 5 effects on one trigger: Manta Scythe, Sky Splitter, Liberator, Taproot, Storm of Salvation.
Stack (Finishing damage on low-health targets): 3 effects on one trigger: Vanquisher, Equinox, Weald. Once a fight started going their way, these finished it.
Stack (Kept alive in fights): 3 effects on one trigger: Equinox, Liberator, Storm of Salvation. Together they made staying in a long fight cheaper: more armor, shields or healing the longer it went.

The Eternal was part of it: Weald (Forage + Taproot) sits on the same triggers as the items (every basic attack set off; healing off the damage; finishing damage on low-health targets), so the same fights paid out in both damage and staying power.

ability.name: Windburn
ability.what: Passive: Every third successful consecutive basic attack will deal 2/2.5/3/3.5/4% of the target’s maximum health as bonus physical damage and heals Yin for +(10/12/14/16/18%) Health.

loadout.plain: Windburn lasts a bit longer and your hits heal you based on missing health while it is active. Turn it on when the fight gets close to sustain through long trades.

loadout.name: Weald
loadout.text: Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) projectiles that each deal 7 (+1 per level) True Damage. Missiles travel through walls and disappear after 3000u. 10s cooldown per Hero. On-hit effects apply at 20% effectiveness.
loadout.plain: When you damage a hero below 30% health, true-damage missiles fly at them through walls, more with bonus attack speed. Rising Storm's attack speed makes it a strong finisher.

loadout.name: Forage
loadout.text: Gain 3 additional Gold and 3 additional XP per Minion or Monster kill.
loadout.plain: Extra gold and XP from minions and monsters. A plain farming boost, nothing tied to the kit.

loadout.name: Taproot
loadout.text: Basic Attacks restore 1 (+6% Bonus Physical Power) Health on-hit. Does not heal from Tower damage.
loadout.plain: Basic attacks heal you a little on hit. Yin attacks fast once Rising Storm stacks, so it adds steady small sustain.

loadout.name: Liberator
loadout.text: Purifying Guard:  Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.
loadout.plain: Removes crowd control and gives a short shield. Use it when stunned or slowed so you can keep attacking and hold your Rising Storm stacks.
